plans.objective: [DIM: composition] The rigid polynomial family exhibits a finite capacity threshold $N_c(w)$ that is invariant to the number of constraints due to its low-dimensional functional form, while the fat polynomial family remains unreachable as its high-dimensional parameter space cannot be constrained by finite samples.

steps.description: Implement the `family` function for two polynomial families (rigid and fat) that returns normalized training/holdout constraint sets (X, y, Xv, yv) with (N,1) shapes. The rigid family will be a low-dimensional polynomial (e.g., 3-5 terms) that can be uniquely determined by w samples, while the fat family will be a high-dimensional random polynomial (e.g., 20 terms) that cannot be constrained by finite samples. Ensure y/yv are normalized to O(1) magnitude and Xv does not overlap with X. This enables the capacity_scan tool to determine N_c(w) for both families.
